title: last hit saver
description: When death is certain… will you run, or will you fight?
body:
last hit saver – A Second Chance at Survival

When your health drops to just a heart, your body refuses to give up.

You enter a powerful Adrenaline Rush state that grants:

⚡ Speed boost 💪 Strength boost 🩸 Intense red vein visual effect on screen 🔊 Sound effects 💬 Dynamic messages like "Adrenaline Rush", "Run!", or "Not Today"

All effects last for 7 seconds, giving you one final moment to:

Escape death 🏃‍♂️ Or fight back and survive ⚔️

To keep things balanced, this ability has a 2-minute cooldown, so every activation truly matters.

Inspired by real-life survival instincts, Last Breath transforms near-death moments into intense, unforgettable experiences.

When death is certain… will you run, or will you fight?
